hypothesis: The ratio-128 learned one-sparse Clark-Hash correction can be added to direct 1.5-bit mask64 ternary Qwen3.8-27B MLP GEMV in one native CPU call while retaining at least 95 percent of mask64-only AVX2 throughput, agreeing with the explicit dequantized formula T x plus A times R x within 5e-4 absolute error, and retaining the at-most-1.57-bit complete component ledger

scope.claim_boundary: synthetic exact-support full-shape fused microkernel only; not a real-weight approximation, complete layer, token-throughput, model-quality, semi-lossless, or breakthrough result

formula.weight_approximation: W approximately equals T plus A R
formula.runtime: y equals T x plus A times R x
formula.ternary_runtime: mask64 support plus support-ordered signs with row-anchor scale4
formula.route: one learned bucket and one learned sign per input coordinate; R x is computed once from groupwise-dequantized Q8 activation
formula.correction: ratio-128 signed INT4 A with one FP16 scale per output row
formula.fusion_boundary: one public C call with one output buffer; R x scratch is at most 136 FP32 values and no dense residual is materialized

measurement.route: deterministic synthetic one-sparse signed routing with the exact learned-route dimensions
measurement.correction_codes: deterministic signed INT4 in [-7,7] with FP16 row scales
measurement.activation: deterministic signed INT8 with per-group FP32 scales
measurement.threading: one process pinned to one physical CPU; kernels are single-threaded
measurement.comparison: one-call fused AVX2 BMI2 kernel versus the same mask64 AVX2 BMI2 base call without correction
measurement.timing_order: alternated by case to reduce systematic first-run bias
measurement.compiler: system C compiler with C11 O3 Wall Wextra Werror shared PIC and mtune=native

promotion_rules: every shape must independently meet correctness storage and fused-overhead thresholds
the control and candidate must use identical mask64 codes scales and activation
the correction must be checked against an explicit dequantized T x plus A times R x oracle
a pass only establishes that the correction path is computationally cheap enough to integrate
real learned routes real coefficients capability and end-to-end token throughput require separate gates
a failed gate remains a terminal useful result and requires a separately versioned optimization
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
Qwen 4B compute is forbidden in this research lane
this benchmark cannot establish semi-lossless compression or a scientific breakthrough
